lookup_details.sql_override:
SELECT 
	COUNT(*) as COUNT_CURRENT 
FROM 
	ERROR_TBL a,

(SELECT 
    MAX(b1.ERROR_DATE) as ERROR_DATE
FROM 
    ERROR_TBL b1
WHERE
	b1.ERROR_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND
	b1.PROCESS_NAME = 'm_Pseudossn_Load_Pseudossn_Tbl'
AND
	SUBSTR(b1.ERROR_MESSAGE, 3, 9) = 'duplicate' ) b

WHERE 
	a.ERROR_DATE = b.ERROR_DATE
AND
	a.PROCESS_NAME = 'm_Pseudossn_Load_Pseudossn_Tbl'

SELECT 
	COUNT(*) as COUNT_CURRENT 
FROM 
	PSEUDOSSN_TBL

SELECT 
	MIN(PSEUDOSSN_TBL.PP_NUM) as PP_NUM, 
	MIN(PSEUDOSSN_TBL.PP_END_YEAR) as PP_END_YEAR 
FROM 
	PSEUDOSSN_TBL
